# D8_TRIGDEBUG_L385f4f2e: vol_2600 on the _CANC print rule + trig_momentum_rsi mom (len 14, lvl 60), both sides, Asia sessions of trading dates 20261110 and 20261109, each plus the 300 bars before it (W-D8SPEC, relay order 0750Z)

Documentation only. This is the PARENT trigger of L385f4f2e.J502 (the pass-2 filter is in D8_P2_J502_FILTER.md). Series: ONE continuous series of all bars of row `vol_2600` on `_CANC` bars (`/mnt/l2/l2vast/_d8spec/bars_c/vol_2600`, 218,428 bars, all sessions, 2023-04 to 2026-11-13), sorted by known time. I recomputed RSI from the stored closes (independent Wilder recursion, max difference to `ind.rsi` 0.0e+00) and the events, and checked that my signals over the whole series equal the module's `signal_fn` output exactly (18,566 signals; equal = True). J502 has 1 surviving event on 20261110; 20261109 is added as the most recent Asia session with 2 or more surviving events (4 parent events, 2 survive).

## Exact definition (code `th_grid/trig_momentum_rsi.py`, `ind.py`)
- **Bar:** vol_2600 = volume bar, threshold 2600 x s_vol contracts per trading date (the vectors file `D8_VECTORS_CANC_L385f4f2e.md` gives the bars, the day's s_vol and threshold).
- **RSI(14), Wilder, on the bar CLOSE of the continuous series** (all sessions, no reset): d[i] = close[i] - close[i-1] (bar 0 has no difference); up = max(d,0), dn = max(-d,0) for i >= 1; avg_up and avg_dn = Wilder RMA of period 14 over the series of diffs starting at bar 1: the first value (at bar 14) is the SIMPLE average of the first 14 diffs, afterwards avg = (avg x 13 + x) / 14; RSI = 100 - 100 / (1 + avg_up / avg_dn) (100 if avg_dn = 0). The value at bar i includes bar i. It is NOT reset at session boundaries (the diff across a session boundary is the plain close-to-close difference of consecutive bars).
- **Event ('mom'):** LONG on the bar where RSI crosses UP through 60 (RSI[i-1] <= 60 and RSI[i] > 60); SHORT where RSI crosses DOWN through 40 (= 100 - 60; RSI[i-1] >= 40 and RSI[i] < 40). Edge events, strict inequality on the new bar, both sides, no warm-up masking beyond the NaN of the first 14 bars. `part = 1` (truncated last bar of a session) bars and sessions other than Asia are dropped by the harness.
- **Event time** = floor(known time of the signal bar to whole seconds) + 2 s (`ny_build.events`: `ts = t_ns // 10**9 + 2`).
- **Bracket plain 60/60:** stop = 60 points and target = 60 points from the entry fill, 1 lot (events file columns stop_pts = 60, tgt_pts = 60). **Flat time** = the end of the signal's session: 02:00 ET = 07:00 UTC (06:00 UTC in EDT) for an Asia signal; then the 120 s rule (`cap_exit`): if no print follows the scheduled exit within 120 s, the exit is the last print before it.
- **Real-roll back-adjust (iid):** this trigger does NOT back-adjust prices (it works on the raw closes and does not use `triggers_b/core.prep`), so the real-roll instrument-id fix has no effect on the parent signals. (It matters for the pass-2 condition GRID_trend_libstack:ema_stack, see D8_P2_J502_FILTER.md.)

## History NT8 must carry (plain paragraph)
RSI(14) with Wilder smoothing seeded at the first bars of the series (April 2023) and never reset: the weight of the seed after N bars is (13/14)^N, 0.1% after 93 bars and 1e-6 after 190 bars, so any bar series that starts more than about 200 bars (vol_2600 makes roughly 300-500 bars per Asia session; about 1,000-1,500 per full trading day) before the first bar tested reproduces RSI to 6 digits; 100 bars give 3 digits. The series must be continuous across sessions (the first bar of Asia uses the last bar of the close session as its previous close) and built with the D8 print rule (daily threshold 2600 x s_vol from the previous 20 days' total volume, accumulation reset at each session boundary, truncated last bar). The crossing test needs the previous bar's RSI, so one extra bar. Start the tick processing at the beginning of the PREVIOUS trading day's Asia session (18:00 ET two days earlier) to have more than 1,000 bars before the first Asia bar.
